title: Chargers RB Keaton Mitchell: Motivating to be somewhere I have a shot to do big things

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Chargers RB Keaton Mitchell: Motivating to be somewhere I have a shot to do big things
sources.description: Chargers offensive coordinator Mike McDaniel showed he had a knack for highlighting fast offensive players when he was the head coach in Miami and that has one of his new players excited about what's coming his way during the 2026 season.
